# Marine profile invariants

The marine profile is selected via `cmake -DTETHYS_PROFILE=marine`. Code under `slave/src/profiles/marine/**` and `slave/profiles/marine.cmake` must uphold every invariant below or document a deviation in `docs/misra-deviations.md` with rationale.

## Invariants (parent plan section 3.3)

| Concern | Invariant |
| --- | --- |
| Transports | CAN-FD + Ethernet (UDP via IEC 61162-450) primary. UART/SxI permitted on dev bench. |
| Endianness | Runtime-detect; both little + big supported. |
| CAL page integrity | Optional CRC (compile-flag `TETHYS_MARINE_CAL_PAGE_CRC=1`). Recommended for production. |
| Watchdog | Optional kick on DAQ tick. XCP must never block the watchdog path. |
| Seed-and-key | Optional, 4-byte. Required when STIM enabled in flight mode. |
| Flight-mode whitelist | Read-only DAQ on entries marked `MARINE_FLIGHT_READABLE` in A2L IF_DATA. STIM permitted under separate whitelist. |
| Logging | Full MDF4. |
| Coding rules | MISRA C:2023 mandatory + required (the `no-recursion-no-goto` rule applies to space only). |
| Standards trace | IEC 60945, IACS UR E22 Rev.3, IACS UR E26/E27. See `docs/research/phase-0-standards-matrix.csv` rows S11/S12/S13/S21/S25/S30. |
